description: Aisha Abdullahi (patient identifier: BAH000008) has been brought to the clinic after experiencing a severe rash following Penicillin administration at another facility. A pharmacist-prepared medication list was brought in by her family showing she was previously prescribed three medications: Penicillin V (antibiotic), Paracetamol (analgesic), and Ferrous Sulfate (iron supplement). The attending clinician must perform a comprehensive medication reconciliation: (1) document the Penicillin allergy in her patient record with appropriate severity and reaction type, (2) identify and discontinue the Penicillin V drug order that was carried over from the medication list, (3) prescribe a safe alternative antibiotic that does not contain penicillin (e.g., Azithromycin, Erythromycin, or Doxycycline), and (4) document a clinical encounter note summarizing the allergy discovery and medication changes.
